en.colourInsights.title: Colour Insights
en.colourInsights.warmDesc: Earth tones and rich, warm hues make you radiate. Lean into camel, terracotta, olive, rust, and gold — they work with your natural warmth rather than against it.
en.colourInsights.coolDesc: Cool, jewel-toned shades bring out the best in you. Navy, burgundy, lavender, cobalt, and rose all complement your undertone beautifully.
en.colourInsights.neutralDesc: You have the most versatile palette — almost any colour works. Anchor looks with navy, camel, or white, then experiment freely with bolder accent shades.
en.colourInsights.completeProfile: Complete your profile to unlock a personalised colour palette based on your unique undertone.

es.colourInsights.title: Información sobre el color
es.colourInsights.warmDesc: Los tonos tierra y los colores cálidos te hacen brillar. Inclínate por camel, terracota, oliva, óxido y dorado: van con tu calor natural.
es.colourInsights.coolDesc: Los tonos joya fríos te favorecen. Navy, burdeos, lavanda, cobalto y rosa complementan tu Subtono a la perfección.
es.colourInsights.neutralDesc: Tienes la paleta más versátil: casi cualquier color funciona. Ancla con navy, camel o blanco y experimenta con acentos más atrevidos.
es.colourInsights.completeProfile: Completa tu perfil para desbloquear una paleta personalizada según tu subtono.
